## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] VisuaLeaf reports that a matching aggregation without command-level maxTimeMS failed with "operation exceeded time limit" under a stored 1 ms budget, then completed after removing the setting. The experiment used MongoDB 9.0.2 and FCV 9.0. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-09) — https://visualeaf.com/blog/mongodb-9-0-whats-new/ · keywords: Per-shape queryKnobs and maxTimeMS (9.0)

## Facts and statements

- [statement] MongoDB 9.0 adds per-shape queryKnobs and maxTimeMS; both require FCV 9.0 or later. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/release-notes/9.0.md · keywords: Per-shape queryKnobs and maxTimeMS (9.0) · also: https://www.nosqlbooster.com/blog/announcing-nosqlbooster-11-2/, https://jalsonic.com/blogs/post/mongodb-9-0-what-s-new-key-features-performance-improvements-and-why-developers-should-upgrade
- [statement] Per-shape knob values override instance-wide parameters and compiled defaults, and apply cluster-wide to the matching shape. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setQuerySettings.md · keywords: Per-shape queryKnobs and maxTimeMS (9.0)
- [statement] queryKnobs updates merge individual knobs; omitted knobs remain unchanged, an empty document does nothing, and null removes one override. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setQuerySettings.md · keywords: Per-shape queryKnobs and maxTimeMS (9.0) · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-123662
- [statement] Per-shape maxTimeMS overrides command maxTimeMS. Zero clears the setting and restores command/defaultMaxTimeMS fallback. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setQuerySettings.md · keywords: Per-shape queryKnobs and maxTimeMS (9.0)
- [statement] Knob overrides must be eligible and FCV-compatible; types, enum values, and parameter bounds are validated. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setQuerySettings.md · keywords: Per-shape queryKnobs and maxTimeMS (9.0) · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-128267
- [statement] Changed queryKnobs values change the plan-cache key, prompting fresh planning. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setQuerySettings.md · keywords: Per-shape queryKnobs and maxTimeMS (9.0)
- [statement] FCV downgrade removes incompatible knobs; upgrading again does not restore them. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setQuerySettings.md · keywords: Per-shape queryKnobs and maxTimeMS (9.0)
- [statement] NoSQLBooster 11.2 documents queryKnobs and maxTimeMS in its editor integration and shows a stored-shape example combining maxTimeMS: 5000 with queryKnobs: { noTableScan: true }. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-26) — https://www.nosqlbooster.com/blog/announcing-nosqlbooster-11-2/ · keywords: Per-shape queryKnobs and maxTimeMS (9.0)
- [statement] SERVER-113079 records historical stale-plan behavior after internalQueryMaxScansToExplode changes; it was closed as a duplicate of query-settings integration work, not evidence of a current 9.0 defect. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-06-04) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-113079 · keywords: Per-shape queryKnobs and maxTimeMS (9.0)
- [statement] Knobs must be explicitly eligible. Validation rejects unknown names, invalid types or ranges, and unmet minimum FCV requirements. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setQuerySettings.md · keywords: Per-shape queryKnobs and maxTimeMS (9.0)
- [statement] The documented setQuerySettings scope covers find, distinct, and aggregate. It does not establish createIndexes support or index-build resumability. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setQuerySettings.md · keywords: Per-shape queryKnobs and maxTimeMS (9.0)
